text:
lin: Heads-up: planning kernel + quant-profile rollout tonight 22:00 UTC. Kernel v3.14 + quant profile q6_2b. Canary 10% -> 50% -> full. Need owners for: slice rotation, smoke checks infra, rollback readiness. Can anyone claim the 22:00-23:00 canary window?
adele: I can own the canary window 22:00-23:00. Will run smoke checklist and hold the rollback key. :thumbsup:
jordan: I can stand up the smoke infra and dashboards. I'll push a lightweight eval set and a quick perf job.
sam: I'll prep rollback steps — snapshot slots, tag model versions, and stage the revert playbook.
maya: I'll coordinate console toggles and make sure alerts are configured (latency, error-rate, kv-hit).
lin: awesome. Adele, high-level smoke checklist we want: 1) p50/p95 latencies within SLO, 2) error rate < 0.5%, 3) token cost delta < 10%, 4) model quality regression on eval set (BLEU/ROUGE/whatever) within threshold, 5) kv-cache hit rate unchanged. Anything missing?
adele: add 6) queue length / backpressure check, 7) spot any increase in retry/fallbacks. I'll annotate thresholds in the canary doc.
jordan: infra notes — I'll spin a canary slice with these labels, and run this rollout config:```yaml
rollout:
  stages:
    - name: canary
      percent: 10
      timeout: 60m
    - name: ramp
      percent: 50
      timeout: 30m
    - name: full
      percent: 100
      timeout: 60m
fallbacks:
  - revert_kernel: true
  - revert_quant: true
```
Use the `deployctl apply-rollout <id>` command once canary is green.
sam: rollback checklist (short):
- tag current kernel/model: `k:v3.13+q6_1b` -> ensure labels on slots
- snapshot runtime slot state (kv cache checkpoint)
- pre-create revert PR for infra and deploy scripts
- make sure canary slices can be force-switched via `deployctl force-slice <slice>`
I'll keep the revert playbook pinned to the thread.
maya: alerts to set before kickoff: latency p95 > 1200ms, error-rate > 0.5% sustained 2m, kv-hit drop > 5% relative. Pager to SRE oncall if any hit. I'll also enable a short retention trace for 30m.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window registered: 2026-07-15T22:00:00Z -> 2026-07-15T23:00:00Z by lin. Rollout id: rlt-2109-canary.
lin: nice — owners: adele (canary watch), jordan (smoke infra + dashboards), sam (rollback + playbook), maya (alerts + console toggles). I'll be the rollback comms and customer-facing status updates.
adele: I'll paste the quick smoke runbook here before 21:45 UTC. Short form:
- run `smoke-runner --eval-set quick_prod_check`
- verify `latency_metrics` & `error_metrics` dashboards
- run 50 parallel gen requests targeting long-context paths
- validate kv-cache hitrate via `kv-monitor --slice canary`
- post results in thread within 10m of stage start

jordan: one more infra note — for quant q6_2b we should disable aggressive batching for the first 10m to reduce emergent latencies. I'll flip batching policy at canary start: `batch-policy: conservative`.
sam: confirmed snapshot commands and revert flags are tested in staging. I'll be on call 21:50-23:30.
maya: console toggles: ready to flip `use_q6_2b` feature flag per stage, and to force traffic-split if needed.
lin: perfect. Minor ask: please ack in this thread once you have your terminal/session ready at 21:45 UTC. We'll only proceed if all ack.
adele: ack — I'll be on 21:40 and will post the runbook.
jordan: ack — smoke infra green at 21:45.
sam: ack — rollback playbook staged, snapshot tested.
maya: ack — alerts set and traces enabled.
lin: thanks team. If canary holds for 60m with thresholds respected, we'll continue to 50% ramp. Otherwise we trigger immediate rollback.
adele: noted. I'll call rollback at first sign of model quality regression.
deploy-bot: Reminder 10m to rollout rlt-2109-canary starting at 2026-07-15T22:00:00Z.
